verdict.rationale: Composio ships official SDKs for both TypeScript (@composio/core) and Python (composio), verified via real installs that imported cleanly, alongside provider adapters that map tools into native framework formats and OpenAPI-documented endpoints. missing for 10: independent third-party tutorials/showcases building production apps with the SDKs, and no evidence of SDKs beyond Python/TypeScript (e.g. Go, Java).
